# Outputs glossary

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_outputs_doc.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

Everything a run produces, column by column. `LifeModel.run()` returns a `RunResult`
(`life_model.results`) holding all of it: `model_frame`, `agent_frame`, `tax_returns`, `ledger`,
`events`, `balance_sheets`, `seed`, `spec`; `to_json` / `to_csv` / `to_parquet` / `load`,
`real_dollars()` (money in start-year dollars) and `explain(year)`. Money is nominal dollars
unless a result is `real`; rates are percents.

## Model frame (one row per year)

`model.datacollector.get_model_vars_dataframe()` / `RunResult.model_frame`. Each column aggregates
a stat over the agents that declare it in `STATS_OWNED` (a joint return's tax stats are split
across both spouses, so the model total is the return's). `STATS` are the default columns of
`get_yearly_stat_df`; `EXTRA_STATS` are collected too.

| Column | Attribute | Set | Owners | Aggregate | Money | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Year | `year` | | LifeModel | | no | The simulated year. |
| Income | `stat_gross_income` | STATS | Job, StockPlan | sum | yes | Gross income made in the year (salary, bonus, RSU vests). |
| Bank Balance | `stat_bank_balance` | STATS | Person | sum | yes | Bank account balances after the year's bills are paid. |
| Brokerage Balance | `stat_brokerage_balance` | STATS | Person | sum | yes | Taxable brokerage balances at year end. |
| 401k Balance | `stat_401k_balance` | STATS | Job401kAccount | sum | yes | 401k balances (pre-tax plus Roth) at year end. |
| Useable Balance | `stat_useable_balance` | STATS | BankAccount, InheritedPretaxAccount, RetirementAccount | sum | yes | Balances usable without penalty (banks, 401ks past 59.5). |
| Debt | `stat_debt` | STATS | Family | sum | yes | Unpaid-bills debt plus outstanding loan and mortgage balances. |
| Taxes | `stat_taxes_paid` | STATS | Person | sum | yes | All taxes paid in the year: federal, state, payroll, NIIT, net of credits. |
| Spending | `stat_money_spent` | STATS | Person | sum | yes | Living expenses plus one-time expenses charged in the year. |
| 401k Contrib | `stat_retirement_contrib` | STATS | Job | sum | yes | Employee 401k deferrals (pre-tax and Roth) in the year. |
| 401k Match | `stat_retirement_match` | STATS | Job | sum | yes | Employer 401k match in the year. |
| RMDs | `stat_required_min_distrib` | STATS | Job401kAccount, TraditionalIRA | sum | yes | Required minimum distributions taken in the year. |
| Housing | `stat_housing_costs` | STATS | Person | sum | yes | Mortgage payments, home expenses and rent paid in the year. |
| Interest Paid | `stat_interest_paid` | STATS | Person | sum | yes | Interest charged on mortgages, loans and carried debt. |
| SS Income | `stat_ss_income` | STATS | Person | sum | yes | Social Security benefits received in the year. |
| Charity | `stat_charitable_donations` | STATS | Donation, DonorAdvisedFund | sum | yes | Charitable donations (direct and DAF grants) in the year. |
| Federal Taxes | `stat_taxes_paid_federal` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Federal income tax, including penalties. |
| State Taxes | `stat_taxes_paid_state` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | State income tax. |
| SS Taxes | `stat_taxes_paid_ss` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Social Security payroll tax. |
| Medicare Taxes | `stat_taxes_paid_medicare` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Medicare payroll tax (incl. the additional tax). |
| Life Ins Premiums | `stat_premium_payments` | EXTRA_STATS | LifeInsurance | sum | yes | Life insurance premiums paid in the year. |
| Life Ins Cash Value | `stat_cash_value` | EXTRA_STATS | LifeInsurance | sum | yes | Whole-life cash value. |
| Death Benefits | `stat_death_benefit_paid` | EXTRA_STATS | LifeInsurance | sum | yes | Life insurance death benefits paid out. |
| Medical Costs | `stat_medical_costs` | EXTRA_STATS | LongTermCare, MedicalCosts, Medicare | sum | yes | Healthcare, Medicare and long-term-care costs. |
| Dependent Costs | `stat_dependent_costs` | EXTRA_STATS | Child | sum | yes | Child and dependent costs charged in the year. |
| Pension Income | `stat_pension_income` | EXTRA_STATS | Pension | sum | yes | Defined-benefit pension income received. |
| NIIT | `stat_taxes_paid_niit` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Net investment income tax. |
| Capital Gains | `stat_capital_gains` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Net capital gains realized (after loss netting). |
| Stock Vested | `stat_stock_vested` | EXTRA_STATS | StockPlan | sum | yes | Value of stock compensation vesting in the year. |
| Stock Unvested | `stat_stock_unvested` | EXTRA_STATS | StockPlan | sum | yes | Value of unvested stock grants at year end. |
| Itemized Deductions | `stat_itemized_deductions` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Itemized deductions claimed (0 when standard was taken). |
| Credits | `stat_tax_credits` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Tax credits (child tax credit, ...) claimed. |
| Penalties | `stat_tax_penalties` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Additional taxes (early-withdrawal penalties); part of Federal Taxes. |
| Net Worth | `stat_net_worth` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Assets minus liabilities at year end (the household balance sheet the conservation check uses). |
| Traditional IRA Balance | `stat_traditional_ira_balance` | EXTRA_STATS | TraditionalIRA | sum | yes | Traditional IRA balances at year end. |
| Roth IRA Balance | `stat_roth_ira_balance` | EXTRA_STATS | RothIRA | sum | yes | Roth IRA balances at year end. |
| HSA Balance | `stat_hsa_balance` | EXTRA_STATS | HealthSavingsAccount | sum | yes | Health savings account balances at year end. |
| 529 Balance | `stat_529_balance` | EXTRA_STATS | Plan529 | sum | yes | 529 education plan balances at year end. |
| Inherited IRA Balance | `stat_inherited_ira_balance` | EXTRA_STATS | InheritedPretaxAccount | sum | yes | Inherited (10-year rule) IRA balances. |
| Annuity Balance | `stat_annuity_balance` | EXTRA_STATS | Annuity | sum | yes | Annuity accumulation balances plus annuitized reserves. |
| DAF Balance | `stat_daf_balance` | EXTRA_STATS | DonorAdvisedFund | sum | yes | Donor-advised fund balances (not counted in net worth). |
| Trust Balance | `stat_trust_balance` | EXTRA_STATS | Trust | sum | yes | Trust balances (only revocable trusts count in net worth). |
| Home Value | `stat_home_value` | EXTRA_STATS | Home | sum | yes | Market value of homes owned at year end. |
| Home Equity | `stat_home_equity` | EXTRA_STATS | Home | sum | yes | Home value minus the mortgage balance. |
| Mortgage Principal | `stat_mortgage_principal` | EXTRA_STATS | Mortgage | sum | yes | Mortgage balances at year end. |
| AGI | `stat_agi` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Adjusted gross income on the year's returns. |
| Taxable Income | `stat_taxable_income` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Taxable income on the year's returns. |
| Marginal Rate | `stat_marginal_rate` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | max | no | Federal ordinary bracket rate (percent) of the last taxable dollar (max across returns). |
| Standard Deduction Taken | `stat_standard_deduction_taken` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | max | no | Whether a return took the standard deduction (True if any did). |
| Forced Sales | `stat_forced_sales` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | Brokerage holdings the payment waterfall sold to pay bills and taxes. |
| Pre-tax Withdrawals | `stat_pretax_withdrawals` | EXTRA_STATS | Person | sum | yes | 401k/IRA/HSA money the payment waterfall withdrew to pay bills and taxes (RMDs excluded). |

## Agent frame (one row per agent per year)

`model.datacollector.get_agent_vars_dataframe()` (indexed by `Step`, `AgentID`) /
`RunResult.agent_frame` (the same rows with `Year`, `Step` and `AgentID` columns). Every model
stat above is also an agent column (None for agents that do not own it), plus:

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Name | The agent's own name: a person's or child's name, a home's name, a job's or account's company, a fund's or card's name. |
| Type | The agent's class (`Person`, `BankAccount`, `Job401kAccount`, ...). |
| Owner | The name of the person the agent belongs to (a person's own name). |
| Salary | This year's base salary (`Salary` rows), read before the year-end raise. |
| Spending Base | This year's base spending (`Spending` rows), read before the year-end increase. |

`model.add_agent_stat(title, attr, pre_post=True)` adds a column read before the `post_step`
escalators the same way.

## Tax returns

`model.tax_returns[(year, unit_id)]` (or `[year]` when the year has one return; `.for_year(year)`),
`person.tax_returns[year]`, `RunResult.tax_returns`: one
`TaxReturn` (`life_model.tax.return_record`) per tax unit per year, built from the numbers the
year was settled with. `total_income - total_adjustments = agi`; `agi - deduction = taxable_income` (both floored at 0); `ordinary_tax + preferential_tax + niit + amt - total_credits + total_penalties = federal_tax`; `federal_tax + state_tax + social_security_tax + medicare_tax = total_tax`, which equals the ledger's tax and penalty outflows for the unit.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `year` | `int` | Tax year. |
| `unit_id` | `int` | The unit head's agent ``unique_id``. |
| `member_ids` | `tuple` | Agent ids of the members filing the return (head first). |
| `member_names` | `tuple` | Names of the members filing the return. |
| `filing_status` | `str` | Filing status name (``SINGLE``, ``MARRIED_FILING_JOINTLY``, ...). |
| `state` | `str` | State the unit files in (the head's). |
| `wages` | `float` | W-2 wages (salary and RSU vests, net of pre-tax 401k deferrals and excluded dependent care benefits), plus taxable dependent care benefits (line 1e). |
| `taxable_interest` | `float` | Taxable interest (bank, corporate and Treasury interest). |
| `tax_exempt_interest` | `float` | Tax-exempt (municipal) interest; not in total income. |
| `ordinary_dividends` | `float` | Ordinary dividends (the model's dividends are all qualified). |
| `qualified_dividends` | `float` | Qualified dividends (taxed on the preferential schedule). |
| `ira_distributions_gross` | `float` | IRA / 401k / inherited-account distributions, gross (qualified charitable distributions included). |
| `ira_distributions_taxable` | `float` | Taxable part of those distributions (all but qualified charitable distributions). |
| `pensions_and_annuities` | `float` | Taxable pension income and the taxable part of annuity payments. |
| `social_security_gross` | `float` | Social Security benefits received. |
| `social_security_taxable` | `float` | Taxable part of the benefits (IRC §86). |
| `short_term_gains_realized` | `float` | Short-term gains realized before loss netting. |
| `long_term_gains_realized` | `float` | Long-term gains realized before loss netting (incl. home sales). |
| `capital_loss_carryforward_used` | `float` | Prior-year capital-loss carryforward absorbed this year. |
| `short_term_gains` | `float` | Net short-term gain taxed (after netting). |
| `long_term_gains` | `float` | Net long-term gain taxed (after netting). |
| `capital_loss_deduction` | `float` | Net capital loss deducted against ordinary income (up to $3,000). |
| `capital_gain_or_loss` | `float` | Line 7: net gain, or the deductible loss as a negative number. |
| `other_income` | `float` | Other income (non-medical HSA draws, 529 earnings, forgiven debt, ...). |
| `other_income_by_source` | `dict` | ``other_income`` by source. |
| `total_income` | `float` | Line 9: sum of the income lines above (excluding tax-exempt interest). |
| `adjustments` | `dict` | Above-the-line adjustments by source (IRA, HSA, student-loan interest, half of SE tax, self-employed plan). |
| `total_adjustments` | `float` | Sum of ``adjustments``. |
| `agi` | `float` | Adjusted gross income: ``max(total_income - total_adjustments, 0)``. |
| `standard_deduction` | `float` | Standard deduction for the filing status plus the §63(f) amount for each member 65+ (0 for MFS when the spouse itemizes). |
| `itemized_deductions` | `float` | Itemized deductions (after the 2026+ §68 limit) compared against the standard deduction. |
| `itemized_components` | `dict` | Itemized deductions by component before the §68 limit (mortgage interest, SALT after the cap, medical, charity in cash and charity_noncash, each after the 2026+ 0.5% floor). |
| `deduction_taken` | `str` | ``standard`` or ``itemized``. |
| `senior_deduction` | `float` | OBBBA senior deduction (added on top of either deduction). |
| `deduction` | `float` | Total deduction subtracted from AGI (lines 12e-14: standard or itemized, the non-itemizer charitable deduction, the senior deduction and the QBI deduction). |
| `taxable_income` | `float` | ``max(agi - deduction, 0)``. |
| `taxable_ordinary_income` | `float` | Part of taxable income taxed on the ordinary brackets. |
| `taxable_preferential_income` | `float` | Part of taxable income taxed on the capital-gains schedule. |
| `ordinary_tax` | `float` | Tax on the ordinary brackets. |
| `ordinary_brackets` | `tuple` | Bracket slices ``(lower, upper, rate_percent, amount, tax)``; their taxes sum to ``ordinary_tax``. |
| `preferential_tax` | `float` | Tax on qualified dividends and long-term gains. |
| `niit` | `float` | Net investment income tax (IRC §1411). |
| `amt` | `float` | Alternative minimum tax (Form 6251 line 11). |
| `credits` | `dict` | Credits by name (``child_tax_credit``, ``earned_income_credit``, ``dependent_care_credit``, ``education_credits``, ``savers_credit``, ``minimum_tax_credit``). |
| `nonrefundable_credits` | `float` | Credits limited to the income tax. |
| `refundable_credits` | `float` | Credits paid even beyond the income tax. |
| `total_credits` | `float` | Sum of ``credits``. |
| `penalties` | `dict` | Additional taxes by source (``early_withdrawal``, ``hsa_non_medical``, ``roth_ira_earnings``, ...). |
| `total_penalties` | `float` | Sum of ``penalties``. |
| `federal_tax` | `float` | Federal income tax: ordinary + preferential + Form 8814 tax + NIIT + AMT - credits + penalties (negative = refund). |
| `fica` | `tuple` | Payroll taxes per member (and each member's Schedule SE profit and tax). |
| `social_security_tax` | `float` | Social Security tax (all members). |
| `medicare_tax` | `float` | Medicare tax including the additional Medicare tax (all members). |
| `additional_medicare_tax` | `float` | Additional Medicare tax on combined wages over the threshold. |
| `state_return` | `life_model.tax.return_record.StateReturn \| None` | State return lines. |
| `state_tax` | `float` | State income tax. |
| `total_tax` | `float` | Everything the unit paid in tax this year: federal + state + payroll + self-employment tax. |
| `marginal_rate` | `float` | Ordinary-bracket rate (percent) of the last taxable ordinary dollar. |
| `effective_rate` | `float` | ``federal_tax / agi`` as a percent (0 when AGI is 0). |
| `business_income` | `float` | Schedule C net profit (Schedule 1 line 3). |
| `taxable_dependent_care_benefits` | `float` | Dependent care benefits over the Form 2441 exclusion (line 1e; in ``wages``). |
| `additional_standard_deduction` | `float` | The §63(f) part of ``standard_deduction`` (members 65+). |
| `charitable_deduction_non_itemizer` | `float` | Non-itemizer cash charitable deduction (2026+, line 12f). |
| `itemized_limitation` | `float` | §68 reduction of itemized deductions (2026+, 2/37 rule). |
| `qualified_business_income` | `float` | Qualified business income (profit less half of SE tax and the self-employed plan). |
| `qbi_deduction` | `float` | Qualified business income deduction (Form 8995). |
| `kiddie_tax` | `float` | Form 8814 tax on a child's interest and dividends (part of line 16). |
| `alternative_minimum_taxable_income` | `float` | Form 6251 line 4. |
| `tentative_minimum_tax` | `float` | Form 6251 line 9. |
| `amt_credit_generated` | `float` | Minimum tax credit this year's AMT creates for later years (Form 8801). |
| `credits_nonrefundable` | `dict` | The nonrefundable part of each credit. |
| `credits_refundable` | `dict` | The refundable part of each credit. |
| `earned_income` | `float` | Earned income for the earned income, additional child and dependent care credits. |
| `self_employment_tax` | `float` | Self-employment tax (Schedule SE line 12, all members). |
| `self_employment_tax_deduction` | `float` | Deductible half of self-employment tax (Schedule 1 line 15). |
| `additional_medicare_tax_self_employment` | `float` | The part of ``additional_medicare_tax`` on self-employment income (Form 8959 Part II; in ``medicare_tax``, on no member's FICA line). |

## Cash-flow ledger

`model.ledger` (`life_model.ledger.CashFlowLedger`); `ledger.to_frame()`, `RunResult.ledger`, and
the DataCollector table `Ledger`. An entry with only `to_account` is an inflow (raises net
worth), one with only `from_account` an outflow, one with both a transfer between household
accounts. Account labels are `<Class>:<unique_id>`, plus `Cash:<person>` (cash held outside
banks) and `Debt:<person>` (unpaid bills carried as debt, a liability).

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `seq` | Position in the ledger (0-based, increasing). |
| `year` | Simulated year. |
| `month` | Month (1-12) once the engine is monthly; empty for the annual engine. |
| `stage` | Model stage that posted it (`pre_step`, `events`, `step`, `post_step`). |
| `kind` | Flow kind (below). |
| `amount` | Dollars moved (negative only for corrections such as a payroll true-up). |
| `from_account` | Household account the money left (empty for an inflow). |
| `to_account` | Household account the money went to (empty for an outflow). |
| `source` | External counterparty of an inflow. |
| `sink` | External counterparty of an outflow. |
| `cause` | Why it happened. |
| `agent_id` | The person it belongs to (agent `unique_id`). |
| `from_name` | Readable name of `from_account`. |
| `to_name` | Readable name of `to_account`. |

| Kind | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `wage` | Salary paid by an employer. |
| `bonus` | Bonus paid by an employer. |
| `vest` | Stock compensation vesting (to cash or a brokerage account), and the spread of exercised stock options. |
| `business_income` | Self-employment net profit (Schedule C) paid to the owner. |
| `interest` | Interest earned (bank accounts). |
| `dividend` | Dividends paid into an account. |
| `growth` | Market growth of an account or asset (negative in a down year). |
| `contribution` | Money put into a savings account (from pay, the bank, or an employer). |
| `match` | Employer 401k match (negative when forfeited). |
| `withdrawal` | Money taken out of a savings account into cash. |
| `rmd` | A required minimum distribution. |
| `sale` | A taxable sale (brokerage holdings, a home). |
| `tax` | Income, payroll and estate taxes (negative for a refund). |
| `penalty` | Additional taxes (early-withdrawal penalties). |
| `spending` | Living expenses and one-time expenses. |
| `housing` | Rent, mortgage payments, property tax, insurance, upkeep, purchase costs. |
| `debt_service` | Loan payments and the interest charged on debt. |
| `premium` | Insurance premiums (and whole-life cash value credited from them). |
| `benefit` | Social Security, pensions, insurance payouts, debt relief. |
| `transfer` | Money moved between household accounts. |
| `gift` | Charity, trust funding, and gifts received. |
| `inheritance` | Assets passing at a death. |
| `borrow` | New debt: unpaid bills carried forward, policy loans. |
| `forfeit` | Value surrendered to a counterparty (unvested match, annuity reserve at death). |
| `opening_balance` | An account or asset that enters the simulation mid-run. |
| `other` | Unclassified external flows (e.g. ``receive_cash`` from user code). |

## Balance sheets and the conservation check

`model.balance_sheets[year]` (opening and closing `BalanceSheet`, and the ledger range posted
during the year) / `RunResult.balance_sheets`. `life_model.checks` asserts that each year's
change in net worth equals the ledger's inflows minus outflows within $1.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `year` | Simulated year. |
| `opening_net_worth` | Household assets minus liabilities before the year's first stage. |
| `closing_net_worth` | The same after the year's last stage (the `Net Worth` column). |
| `inflows` | Ledger inflows posted during the year. |
| `outflows` | Ledger outflows posted during the year. |

## Events

`model.event_log` (`.list`, `.of_kind`, `.for_year`, `.to_frame()`), `RunResult.events`. The
notebook table (`_repr_html_`) shows the life story; detail kinds are kept but not shown there.

| Column | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `year` | Year it happened. |
| `kind` | Event kind (below). |
| `person` / `person_id` | Who it is about. |
| `amount` | Dollars involved, when any. |
| `account` / `account_name` | Account involved (ledger label and readable name). |
| `cause` | Why it happened. |
| `message` | Display text. |
| `details` | Kind-specific extras, as JSON (e.g. a pre-tax withdrawal's `target`). |

| Kind | Detail | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `note` |  | Free-text event (what Event(message) creates); most legacy messages. |
| `life_event_fired` |  | A scheduled LifeEvent fired (details: stage; the record also has name and scheduled_year). |
| `retired` |  | A job ended (retirement, a layoff, death). |
| `retirement_age` |  | A person reached the federal retirement age (59.5). |
| `married` |  | Two people married (details: spouse). |
| `died` |  | A person died. |
| `home_bought` |  | A home was bought (amount: price; cause: the purchase). |
| `home_sold` |  | A home was sold (amount: price; details: net_proceeds, taxable_gain). |
| `policy_lapsed` |  | A life insurance policy lapsed (cause: non-payment, or a loan above the cash value). |
| `annuitized` |  | An annuity converted to income payments (amount: reserve; details: monthly_payout). |
| `inheritance` |  | Assets passed at a death (estate, designated account, trust payout, inherited IRA done). |
| `forced_sale` | yes | Detail: the payment waterfall sold brokerage holdings (amount, account, cause). |
| `pretax_withdrawal` | yes | Detail: the waterfall withdrew pre-tax money (amount; details: target = the solver's size). |
| `withdrawal` | yes | Detail: the waterfall drew Roth money. |
| `rmd` | yes | Detail: a required minimum distribution (amount, account). |
| `penalty` | yes | Detail: an additional tax settled with the year's return (amount; cause: its source). |
| `shortfall_debt` | yes | Detail: bills the household could not pay, carried as debt (amount, cause). |
